summary: Full happy-path E2E verified. Backend and frontend both green. Staff/Client/Rule created via API, generate_today created 1 task (dedup on re-run), inline complete + manual task creation via header dialog worked, dashboard stats updated from 1->2 today's tasks with 1 completed.
passed: GET /api/dashboard/stats returns all 9 fields and updates correctly (todays_tasks 0->2, completed_today 0->1, pending 1, total_clients 1, total_staff 1, active_rules 1)
POST /api/staff creates staff with auto initials (TU)
POST /api/clients creates client; duplicate code returns 400
POST /api/rules creates monthly rule for today's day-of-month
POST /api/tasks/generate_today: first call created 1 task from matching rule; second call returned created=0, skipped_existing=1 (no duplicates)
PATCH /api/tasks status=completed sets completed_at; reopen (status=pending) clears completed_at
GET /api/tasks filters (due_date, status, staff_id, client_id, overdue) all return correct counts
Frontend / route loads Morning Cockpit with all 5 KPI cards (kpi-card-total/completed/pending/overdue/hold) visible
Sidebar navigation (nav-morning-cockpit, nav-todays-work, nav-client-master, nav-recurring-rules) routes correctly
btn-generate-todays-work triggers generation, navigates to /today, and generated task 'GSTR-3B Filing' visible
task-complete-{id} inline action transitions task to completed and dashboard reflects Completed=1
btn-new-task dialog opens; task-client-select + task-name-input + task-save-btn creates 'Manual Test Task' visible in Today's Work
Toast notifications ('Task created') render via sonner
notes: Only console warnings observed are Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby (a11y warning, non-blocking). No credentials required (auth disabled by design).
